title: ENDEX card
description: Facilitator control card that ends play: reads the resolution aloud and moves the room into the hot wash (debrief).

exerciseTime.description: Exercise clock when the card is read, H:MM

endTime.description: In-scenario wall-clock time when play stops

resolution.description: How the scenario resolves; the facilitator reads this aloud to stop play (2-4 sentences, starts with ENDEX)
examples: ENDEX. The board flickers and resets: UA 1245 to Chicago, ON TIME. The screens are restored. This concludes the exercise.

finalState.description: Facts that are true at ENDEX (2-5 short lines)

examples: FIDS restored from verified 04:00 AM backup

hotWashTransition.description: What the facilitator says to move the room from play into the hot wash
examples: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.

hotWashMethod.description: Debrief method used to open the hot wash
examples: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke

hotWashQuestions.description: Key discussion questions for the hot wash (3-5)

examples: At what point did you stop trusting the screens? Why did it take so long?

facilitatorNote.description: Private note for the facilitator (not read aloud)
examples: Collect all ICS 201 forms and evaluator sheets before the break.
